base_envelope_shape.edges: must be a list and every element must satisfy judgments.GenericEdgeShape
base_envelope_shape.ordering: judgments.GenericEnvelopeShape is decided before supported/unsupported spec_id dispatch
base_envelope_shape.string_members: spec_id, artifact_type, and version must be nonempty strings

closure_algorithm: derive the direct operational role map from record mode/family and pinned validator configuration
require the signed trace operational_reference_map to equal that derived map
resolve each hash from the immutable ArtifactIndex snapshot
apply judgments.OpaqueLeaf or judgments.GenericEnvelopeShape before spec_id dispatch
return UNKNOWN without traversal for a complete unsupported envelope
for supported envelopes only, validate direct field roles, version, semantic discriminator and SupportedEdgeRelation
walk supported role-bearing edges breadth-first with cycle detection
validate resolved supported child envelope type when expected_type is not opaque-content
require resolved_evidence_hashes to equal the fixed-point closure

edge_shape.generic_syntax: defined by judgments.GenericEdgeShape and applicable to all envelopes
edge_shape.supported_relation: defined by judgments.SupportedEdgeRelation and applicable iff spec_id is supported

envelope_classification_order: judgments.OpaqueLeaf handles an artifact without artifact_envelope
if judgments.GenericEnvelopeShape holds and spec_id is unsupported, classify Unsupported/UNKNOWN without judgments.SupportedEdgeRelation
if spec_id is supported, require judgments.SupportedEnvelopeHeader then apply judgments.SupportedEdgeRelation
traverse only a supported well-typed envelope

constraints: sha256 is a syntactically valid SHA-256 content address
role is unique within the parent envelope
does_not_require: artifact_type is present in the current EDGE_RELATIONS domain
role is present in a current parent-type relation
expected_type equals a current parent-role target type
GenericEdgeShape.quantifier: for every edge in every artifact_envelope before spec_id dispatch

predicate: spec_id, artifact_type, version, and edges are present
spec_id, artifact_type, and version are nonempty strings
GenericEnvelopeShape.quantifier: for every artifact object containing artifact_envelope before spec_id dispatch

true_result.dispatch_rule: exactly one of judgments.UnsupportedEnvelope or judgments.SupportedEnvelopeHeader is selected by spec_id equality

OpaqueLeaf.applicable_when: an artifact object does not contain artifact_envelope
OpaqueLeaf.result: opaque leaf; envelope classification is not applied

SupportedEdgeRelation.not_applicable_when: the complete generic envelope has an unsupported spec_id or judgments.SupportedEnvelopeHeader fails
SupportedEdgeRelation.predicate: EDGE_RELATIONS[artifact_type][role] equals expected_type for every edge
SupportedEdgeRelation.totality: for every applicable envelope exactly one of false_result or true_result is selected by the predicate

SupportedEnvelopeHeader.predicate: envelope.version equals 0.2.6 and envelope.artifact_type is in the current EDGE_RELATIONS domain

SupportedTraversal.transition: enqueue every relation-valid edge exactly once by content hash; dispatch each resolved child through child_dispatch; stop at the unique fixed_point_results branch

UnsupportedEnvelope.predicate: judgments.GenericEnvelopeShape holds and spec_id is not the supported closure spec_id
UnsupportedEnvelope.traversal: do not traverse edges because their semantics are outside this validator version

normative_precedence: The complete normative classification graph is the judgments object, including every structured false_result, true_result, child_dispatch, and fixed_point_results branch. Every symbolic dependency or transition reference must be a fully qualified judgments.<name> reference resolving inside this object. Top-level base_envelope_shape, closure_algorithm, edge_shape, and envelope_classification_order are derived views with no independent normative force.
